description: Synthetic, deterministic race (it always loses; a natural race would pass intermittently). The fixture answers /api/profile correctly after 1.5 s. The test checks the heading with a web-first assertion (static, passes at once), then reads isVisible() for 'Dana Demo' once, which returns false while the page still shows 'Loading your profile…'. The attempt fails in well under a second with Expected true / Received false, not a timeout. The control, the same test with web-first toBeVisible assertions, passes against the same 1.5 s delay, so the app works and the defect is the missing wait.

tests.title: shows the signed-in user on the profile page

rootCause.summary: expect(await locator.isVisible()).toBe(true) checks once, immediately after the heading appears, while /api/profile is still pending; the profile renders later, so a retrying (web-first) assertion would pass.

criteria.description: Identifies the one-shot isVisible() check that does not wait or retry
Connects it to the page still loading the profile
Calls it a timing / synchronization problem in the test

forbiddenClaims.description: Blames the backend as slow or broken
Claims the API returned an error
Describes the failure as a timeout

requiredEvidence.why: Failure data must come from the MCP tools
The one-shot isVisible() check is in the test source
Confirmed (Playwright 1.64.1): the page snapshot at failure shows the paragraph "Loading your profile…" and no profile details
